judged_rule: every run is published: Code quality is the equal mean of both judges, who each reviewed every run
single_judge_rule: combined_single_judge recomputes the combined score with Code quality from one judge's reviewed score and intent recovery alone; it is a sensitivity figure, not the published score
intent_recovery_rule: When a submission passed no quirk family, intent recovery has no denominator and its 9 points move to the reviewed score for that submission (intent_recovery_redistributed); 3 GPT-6.1 Terra runs needed it
recovery_rule: operator_recovery names the one call published through an operator rule: Muse Spark 1.3's intent probe of max settlecore, whose quoted byte-string escapes were decoded into control characters and are written back as the source spells them (recover_escaped_excerpts, owner decision 2026-10-29)
hidden_behaviour_fields: hidden_behaviours counts the task's fail-to-pass hidden tests; hidden_behaviours_fixed counts those the run passed

cost_fields.estimated_usd: API-equivalent at the published list rates, stamped by the sweep at run time and recomputed from the Codex receipt with cached input at the cache-read rate

token_fields.raw_tokens: Codex raw total: input (cached included) plus output
token_fields.token_usage.reasoning_output_tokens: the part of output Codex reports as reasoning

codex_notice_rule: codex_notices lists Codex's own warnings in the run's event stream: model_metadata_fallback is its notice that it had no model metadata for gpt-6.1-terra and used fallback metadata
model_identity: requested-only: Codex does not report the serving model, so identity is the model requested (gpt-6.1-terra)
